svg.text: cc-tree — one run, grown as a radial tree
every expansion tries all 12 framings · only advances children grow further · it stops on §6 convergence, not a node budget
this run: CONVERGED · n = 49 nodes · width = 45 tips · depth 3
A topic, a document, a code path or a
design prompt. Depth 0; the tree grows
Every expansion runs all twelve, so a
node that grows gets one child per
framing — here the root's are lettered
An idea, critique, option or finding with
An open dot is an advances node that
How far a node is from the root. Only
branches stop on different rings; this
Every terminal tip, wherever it lands: 45
here. kept and pruned tips count where
they stop; an advances tip counts once
advances — score ≥ 11; re-expanded. A tip only once its own re-expansion found nothing new
kept — score 8–10; stays in the tree, not re-expanded
pruned — score ≤ 7; derivation kept for reference, not re-expanded
blocked — incomplete; must be finished, never counts as a tip (none left once converged)
open dot — an advances node that grew children (only advances nodes grow)
One engine, four presets — a run uses one; the roles are the same, the words differ (§5.2)
